fix_round_disclosure: Supersedes the first version of this receipt. That version (a) preregistered at 2026-09-23T01:45:00Z while the fixture calls it describes had already run against a server that had fully shut down by 01:44:32Z (late preregistration, not labelled as such); (b) sent fidelityGate.enabled=true explicitly in every request -- a parameter not present in the original failing receipt's shape -- and then read the resulting reject-and-fallback as 'neither engine corrupted or dropped the required sentinel/numeric values', when the rejectReason itself said the engine detected the '5' would be lost, i.e. the corrupting transform was still attempted internally and only caught by a gate this run turned on; (c) ran the isolated instance with DATA_DIR set but HOME unset, so OmniRoute's startup unconditionally also loaded the live ~/.omniroute/.env (upstream behavior: bin/omniroute.mjs always calls addEnvPath(getDefaultDataDir()/.env) regardless of DATA_DIR) and read STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY from the live store, and made outbound Arena/OpenRouter syncs; (d) recorded the reset-password command without DATA_DIR, which -- taken literally -- targets the live store's default data dir; (e) committed the throwaway dashboard password in plain text; (f) left the scratch data-1790127756 directory (encrypted with the live key) on disk afterward. This receipt records a new, corrected re-run: HOME was pointed at a scratch directory before starting the server (so getDefaultDataDir() resolves under the scratch HOME and never touches ~/.omniroute), the admin password was set via INITIAL_PASSWORD in the isolated server's own environment (no reset-password.mjs call, no DATA_DIR ambiguity), the request bodies used NO explicit fidelityGate/fuzzyDedup override (matching the original failing receipt's shape, which recorded no such flags), the throwaway password was generated with openssl rand and is not reproduced in this receipt, and the stale contaminated scratch data directory from the first run was deleted. Full request and response bodies are kept under raw/gap2-rerun/ in this directory.
